features.name: Inverse-flow teacher transport
features.description: Transport paired simulator-verified safe-progress action targets through the exact frozen pi0.5 sampler into budgeted time-dependent residual velocities
features.evidence: IFT-00 passed only as synthetic implementation evidence; evidence/r05a/ift00-synthetic.json. Historical IFT-00A attempts, CFS launch A, and CFS run B at tasks 28048_0/28049 remain preserved. Diagnostic A tasks 28212_0/28213 were apparatus-inconclusive because server_timing blocked preservation of the finite-difference terminal. ADR-0048 repaired only that exact transport boundary. Corrected immutable run r05a-constrained-flow-fd-diagnostic-20260716b used release 1e2d36d: GPU task 28222_0 and CPU publisher 28223 both completed 0:0, all 99 allocation tests passed with zero skips, host/GPU use was about 15.0 GiB/8.5 GiB with no OOM, and zero generated simulator actions ran. The full float32 35-by-75 Jacobian and all six fixed finite-difference comparisons were preserved and independently reconstructed. Every check failed with relative errors 0.626 to 0.993; ADR-0049 retires only that autograd-linearized submethod while leaving the broader actual-forward hypothesis open. ADR-0050 preregistered AF-00A, a fixed 520-query actual-forward CEM teacher with 534 ordinary sampler requests. Launches A/B were zero-runtime parser failures preserved by ADR-0052/0054. Behavior-tested release bd14f97 completed GPU task 28281_0 on worker-1 in 00:03:18 with all 36 allocation tests passing and exact payload/tensor/ledger evidence. CPU publisher 28282 failed before results.json because the recomputed and R02-reported binary64 norms differ by one ULP; both cast to the exact registered float32 budget used by every control. ADR-0057 recovery publisher 28291 then completed 0:0 on worker-0 with two CPUs, 8 GiB, and no GPU, preserving the original failed receipt and publishing result SHA-256 507f25bc381b7bfeaa30abe3a7df970681f3b175f39221034c6e768e72dae914 plus receipt SHA-256 5462f875ffb41a84a06c4df715366776af3811f3229385d05be8f5b0dafcb632. The official outcome is frozen_cem_negative: changed Arm B improves the objective only slightly and remains far outside all four fidelity gates; reverse C is worse. ADR-0058 closes this exact one-case CEM, not the broader transport hypothesis. ADR-0059's sealed 520-query diagnostic shows the equal-split residual directly supplies the target direction but the changed Pi0.5 base field cancels about 40 percent; all 520 observed feedback components are adverse, while the fixed CEM is also sample-inefficient. ADR-0060 preregisters TRL-00A, an optimizer-free online reference-trajectory lift that reevaluates the base field at each actual state, compares exact same-budget B/B5 projection with raw authority, and replays every finite schedule through the ordinary sampler. The finite-only implementation and independent CPU publisher pass the complete 753-test local gate plus focused producer/validator/HPC reviews with no open P0/P1; no TRL H100 job has yet been submitted. No teacher-generated action has been executed in the simulator. The current gate continues to forbid solver tuning or IFT-01; automatic resubmission, tolerance tuning, efficacy or infeasibility claims, label collection, probe training, and residual-field MLP training remain blocked.
